questions.question: Is Tableboard Studios making Project 2026?
questions.detail: The official Tableboard Studios Roblox group lists “Project 2026 (2026) — To be announced” under Current Games, and founder Bryce_TBS lists Project 2026 first under Current Projects on his Roblox profile.

questions.question: Are they currently testing it internally?
questions.detail: Supporting evidence: Roblox lists a “Project 2026 Testing Server”, described as “the official testing server for Tableboard Studios's newest game”, in the studio's invite-only development group (created 7 Dec 2025, last updated 20 Oct 2026), next to a “P26 Building Systems Development” place. Rotraces lists both too. The studio hasn't posted a public testing announcement.

questions.question: Are they finalizing internal testing?
questions.detail: Nothing public says testing is in its final stage, and nothing says it isn't. The testing places were still being updated on 20 Oct 2026, and the official listing still reads “To be announced”.

stages.label: Announced
stages.note: Listed on the official group as “To be announced”

stages.label: Internal testing
stages.note: YES: confirmed by site owner, official testing server listed

updates.title: Tracker v1.3: revamp
updates.text: New look for the tracker: a cruise-ship themed design with the three answers as big cards at the top, an “At a glance” dashboard (progress, live stats with a visits sparkline, latest auto-check), search across the updates and FAQ (press /), a “Copy summary” button and link previews when the page is shared. No facts changed: the answers are still YES, YES, NOT CONFIRMED.

updates.title: Tracker v1.2: automatic checks
updates.text: The tracker now checks Roblox by itself. A GitHub bot reads the test places, the studio groups, the founder's profile and both groups' game lists every 6 hours, and adds an “Auto-detected” entry here when something changes. The page also re-checks every 2 minutes while it's open. The answers are unchanged: YES, YES, NOT CONFIRMED. The bot can't change them; it raises an attention flag instead.

updates.title: Tracker v1.1: official testing-server listing found
updates.text: New evidence for the testing answer. The “Project 2026 Testing Server” is listed by Roblox under the studio's own invite-only Tableboard Studios Development group, not only on a third-party tracker. The answers are unchanged: YES, YES, NOT CONFIRMED.

updates.title: Tracker launched
updates.text: Status set: Making Project 2026 — YES. Testing internally — YES (confirmed by site owner). Finalizing testing — NOT CONFIRMED.

updates.title: Official group still says “To be announced”
updates.text: Checked today: the Tableboard Studios group (46,452 members) lists “Project 2026 (2026) — To be announced” under Current Games. No release date, trailer or feature list.

updates.title: Founder's profile lists Project 2026
updates.text: Checked today: Bryce_TBS (Founder, CEO & Lead Developer) lists Project 2026 first under Current Projects, ahead of Cruise Ship Simulator.

updates.title: Private testing places spotted
updates.text: Checked today: rotraces.com lists “Project 2026 Testing Server” and “P26 Building Systems Development” under Bryce_TBS. Neither is in the main group's public game list.

updates.title: Studio website doesn't mention it yet
updates.text: Checked today: the Tableboard Studios projects page only covers the older Cruise Line Simulator games.

updates.title: Cruise Ship Simulator updated
updates.text: Roblox shows Cruise Ship Simulator was last updated on 26 Oct 2026.

updates.title: Both Project 2026 test places updated
updates.text: Roblox records the Project 2026 Testing Server as updated at 21:19 UTC and P26 Building Systems Development at 21:31 UTC on 20 Oct 2026.

updates.title: “P26 Building Systems Development” created
updates.text: A second Project 2026 place appears in the studio's development group, for building systems. It has no public description.

updates.title: “World's Largest Cruise Ship” badge added
updates.text: Badge creation date in Cruise Ship Simulator, from Roblox's badge list.

updates.title: Grand Cayman badge added
updates.text: Badge creation date in Cruise Ship Simulator.

updates.title: Studio teases a big Cruise Ship Simulator update
updates.text: On TikTok the studio promised characters walking on ships again, animated NPC passengers and 4 new ships, “including the highly anticipated Dream Class”, expected 13–14 Dec.

updates.title: Project 2026 Testing Server created
updates.text: Roblox's creation date for the testing server. Its description: “The official testing server for Tableboard Studios's newest game. This game and it's contents are NDA, nothing may be posted publicly without permission from the development team.”

updates.title: “You're a Billionaire!” badge added
updates.text: For earning $1,000,000,000 in Cruise Ship Simulator. Rewards include the Njord Class Yacht with 4 exclusive musical horns. 325 players had earned it as of 28 Oct 2026.

updates.title: Oasis Class badge added
updates.text: Badge creation date in Cruise Ship Simulator.

updates.title: Studio announces its “largest update ever”
updates.text: On TikTok: 3 new cruise ships, tugs, LNG ships, weather, waves “and so much more” for Cruise Ship Simulator.

updates.title: Triton Class badge added
updates.text: Badge creation date in Cruise Ship Simulator.

updates.title: Cruise Ship Simulator created
updates.text: The studio's current game goes up on Roblox. A “Cruise Ship Simulator Testing Server” was created the same day in the development group, the same pattern Project 2026 follows now.

updates.title: Cruise Line Simulator: A New Era created
updates.text: The studio's second game. It reached 5,384,286 visits and is now listed as discontinued.

updates.title: Cruise Line Simulator: Classic created
updates.text: The studio's first listed game (346,739 visits). Now discontinued; its page points players to Cruise Ship Simulator.

updates.title: Tracker v2.0: full modern redesign
updates.text: Complete visual rewrite: aurora glass design with animated gradient backdrop, frosted glass cards and header, a bento
dashboard, glowing progress tracker and timeline, gradient typography, scroll progress bar and refined light theme. Same facts throughout: still YES, YES, NOT CONFIRMED.
